items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed. Do not clear go-live, new public exposure, or security-sensitive release gates. High risk for those decisions because fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, or findings; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error sweep results. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown. No credential exposure, exploit, or vulnerability is established. Recommendation: preserve current gates; permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Complete the existing consolidated read-only security evidence matrix using retained artifacts and authorized metadata only. Record dated evidence, affected scope, owners, severity, and release implications for authentication/access, secrets, isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, alter permissions or configuration, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
